entries.261e06da444f703f: This business rents out real estate, mainly residential rental condominiums. Centered on Kobe City and the Hanshin area, it develops rental condominiums that emphasize transport convenience, mainly within a 1 km radius of stations, and also carries out development by purchasing existing properties and renovating them under a value-up approach. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥3,295 million, and as of the end of February 2026 it owned 107 buildings and 2,218 units, with an occupancy rate of 97.93%.
entries.320542b758584da8: A real estate company that develops and sells "Wacore" condominiums for sale and operates a rental condominium business in Kobe, Akashi, the Hanshin area and Osaka Prefecture.

entries.80abd0b66ab2fc1c: This business mainly develops, plans and sells residential land, rental real estate and similar properties. In addition to selling small income properties and residential land, it also sells owned real estate where the sale is expected to increase its value in the course of making effective use of that real estate. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥2,680 million.
entries.89468bbae4e949e7: This business develops, plans and sells detached houses. Its main business areas are Kobe City, Akashi City and the Hanshin area, and it places emphasis on added value such as the design and planning capabilities built up through condominium sales; even small developments of about 10 units are based on creating streetscapes. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥1,763 million.

entries.f2021c3d3d4efc65: This business develops, plans and sells condominiums for sale under the 'Wakōre' brand. It mainly builds medium-sized condominiums of around 50 units, with its main areas being the Kobe and Akashi area, the Hanshin area, the area around Itami City, Takarazuka City and Himeji City, and Osaka Prefecture. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥34,175 million, the largest of the reportable segments, and cumulative supply on a construction-start basis as of the end of February 2026 was 588 buildings and 23,095 units.
